items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: Well when I first joined the band I was playing it similar to the way Alex did.

ctx.x: When did “Birdland” move from like straight eighth notes into this nasty shuffle?

Well when I first joined the band I was playing it similar to the way Alex did. And just for the record when I heard that for the first time it was such a magical sounding recording and I told Jaco, I said, “This is the version of Weather Report I’ve been waiting for.” And I was fine, like just let it be Alex, Manolo, Joe, Wayne, and Jaco for the rest of time.
